violation_type.title: Free from other activities: Janitorial duties (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(4)(B))
violation_type.short_title: Free from other activities: Janitorial duties
violation_type.typical_finding: The primary caregiver was seen cleaning (vacuuming)  her daycare space while the children were present; the children were playing freely as she performed her cleaning tasks. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver was warned about this standard.
